checks: Source 2a206064c18d19c5 §5 (10)–(11) gives the old whole-row contact used in §6 (12)–(15). The frozen claim takes those exact conditions as hypotheses and makes no use of the proposed chart construction.

Affineness and the row barycenter give each old and new mass as m_i L(Y_i). Substituting W-L=b·(w-Y_i) and subtracting Y_i inside the first moment gives the covariance with no missing base-coordinate term.
An exact two-point row at (0,0) and (2,1) with equal weights, L=B=2 and W=1+z has equal masses and drift (1,1/2), the first covariance column. This also checks the sign of the drift.

The density ratio g=W/L is bounded above and below on the compact support. Its mean under η/s is one. Jensen for both -log g and g log g gives the two nonnegative relative entropies, and strict convexity gives precisely g=1 almost everywhere. Empty groups have zero integrals.
